policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Employees are entitled to 18 paid annual leave days per calendar year.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Annual leave must be requested through the HR portal using the Annual Leave Request Form.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Notice
policies.text: Employees should normally submit annual leave requests at least 3 working days before the intended leave date.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Half-day Leave
policies.text: Annual leave may be taken in half-day increments.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Carry Forward
policies.text: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the following calendar year. Carry-forward days expire after the following calendar year.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Encashment
policies.text: Eligible unused annual leave may be encashed at separation, subject to company policy and applicable rules.
policies.rule: Eligibility is determined during separation processing.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Approval
policies.text: A manager may decline or request a different leave date when there is a genuine operational requirement.

policies.name: Annual Leave
policies.title: Separation
policies.text: Eligible unused annual leave is handled during separation according to the leave encashment policy.
policies.rule: Final treatment is determined during separation processing.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Employees receive 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Sick leave should be recorded through the HR portal as soon as reasonably possible.
policies.rule: Notify the company and record the absence in the HR portal.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Medical Certificate
policies.text: A medical certificate is required when sick leave exceeds 2 consecutive working days.
policies.rule: Medical certificate required after 2 consecutive working days.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Unexpected Illness
policies.text: If an employee becomes suddenly ill and cannot apply beforehand, they should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible and record the sick leave when able.
policies.rule: Prompt notification is required where practical.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Half-day Leave
policies.text: Sick leave may be taken in half-day increments.

policies.name: Sick Leave
policies.title: Carry Forward
policies.text: Unused sick leave does not carry forward to the next calendar year.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Unpaid leave may be requested when paid leave has been exhausted or for a genuine personal reason, subject to approval.
policies.rule: Paid leave should generally be exhausted first, unless HR approves otherwise.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Employees must submit an Unpaid Leave Request Form through the HR portal and obtain the required manager and HR approvals.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Approval
policies.text: Approval depends on the reason, operational impact, available paid leave, and manager and HR review.

policies.name: Unpaid Leave
policies.title: Salary Impact
policies.text: Salary is reduced in proportion to approved unpaid leave days.
policies.rule: Unpaid days are unpaid and reduce salary accordingly.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Eligible employees may receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Employees who have completed 6 months of continuous employment are eligible following birth, adoption, or placement of a child.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Notice
policies.text: Employees should normally submit parental leave requests 30 days in advance where reasonably possible.
policies.rule: 30 days' advance notice where reasonably possible.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Documentation
policies.text: HR may request reasonable supporting documentation relating to birth, adoption, or placement.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Splitting Leave
policies.text: Parental leave may be taken continuously or in up to two blocks, subject to HR approval.

policies.name: Parental Leave
policies.title: Paid Status
policies.text: Eligible parental leave is paid for up to 16 weeks under company policy.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Combining Leave
policies.text: Different leave types may be combined where each leave type's eligibility and approval requirements are met.
policies.rule: Each leave type must independently satisfy its requirements.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Unauthorized Absence
policies.text: Unapproved absence may be treated as unauthorized absence and may affect attendance records and pay, subject to company procedures.
policies.rule: Approval should be obtained before leave except in genuine emergencies.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Leave Balance
policies.text: Employees can view their current leave balance in the HR portal.
policies.rule: Check the HR portal for the current balance.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Support
policies.text: Employees should contact their reporting manager for approval questions and HR Operations for policy or system questions.

policies.name: General Leave
policies.title: Urgent Leave
policies.text: For urgent leave, employees should notify their reporting manager as soon as possible and submit the appropriate leave request through the HR portal when practical.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Employees may receive up to 5 paid working days of bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Eligibility
policies.text: Bereavement leave applies to the death of an immediate family member, including a spouse, parent, child, sibling, or legal guardian.

policies.name: Bereavement Leave
policies.title: Application
policies.text: Employees should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible and submit the Bereavement Leave Form when practical.
policies.rule: Prompt notification; documentation may be requested.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Eligible birthing employees may take up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Start Date
policies.text: Maternity leave may begin up to 8 weeks before the expected date of delivery.
policies.rule: May start up to 8 weeks before expected delivery.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Notice and Documentation
policies.text: Employees should notify HR at least 8 weeks before the planned start date and provide a medical certificate confirming the expected delivery date.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Return to Work
policies.text: Employees returning from maternity leave are entitled to return to the same or an equivalent role and may request flexible working for up to 6 months after return.
policies.rule: Same/equivalent role; flexible working up to 6 months.

policies.name: Maternity Leave
policies.title: Nursing Breaks
policies.text: Employees returning from maternity leave are entitled to two paid 30-minute nursing breaks per working day until the child is 15 months old.
policies.rule: Two paid 30-minute breaks daily until child is 15 months.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: Eligible non-birthing parents, including fathers and partners, may take up to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Timing
policies.text: Paternity leave must be taken within 6 months of the child's birth or placement, continuously or in two separate weeks.
policies.rule: Within 6 months; up to two blocks.

policies.name: Paternity Leave
policies.title: Notice
policies.text: Employees should give at least 4 weeks' notice of paternity leave where reasonably possible.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Prenatal Appointments
policies.text: Pregnant employees are entitled to paid time off to attend prenatal medical appointments, and partners may take paid time off to attend up to 2 such appointments.
policies.rule: Paid prenatal appointments; partners up to 2.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Pregnancy-Related Illness
policies.text: Absence due to pregnancy-related illness is recorded separately from regular sick leave and does not reduce the sick leave balance.

policies.name: Pregnancy-Related Leave
policies.title: Pregnancy Loss
policies.text: Employees who experience miscarriage or stillbirth, and their partners, may take up to 2 weeks of paid leave.

policies.name: Adoption Leave
policies.title: Entitlement
policies.text: The primary adopter may take up to 16 weeks of paid adoption leave from the date of placement; the secondary adopter is eligible for paternity leave.
policies.rule: Primary adopter 16 weeks paid; secondary adopter uses paternity leave.

faqs.q: How much maternity leave do I get?
faqs.a: Eligible birthing employees may take up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.

faqs.q: When can I start my pregnancy leave before delivery?
faqs.a: Maternity leave may begin up to 8 weeks before the expected date of delivery.

faqs.q: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get?
faqs.a: Eligible non-birthing parents may take up to 2 weeks of paid paternity leave.

faqs.q: Can I take time off for prenatal or pregnancy checkups?
faqs.a: Pregnant employees get paid time off for prenatal appointments; partners may attend up to 2.

faqs.q: Does pregnancy sickness count against my sick leave?
faqs.a: No. Pregnancy-related illness is recorded separately from sick leave.

faqs.q: Is there leave after a miscarriage?
faqs.a: Employees and partners may take up to 2 weeks of paid leave after miscarriage or stillbirth.

faqs.q: Do I get breastfeeding or nursing breaks after returning?
faqs.a: Two paid 30-minute nursing breaks per day until the child is 15 months old.

faqs.q: How much adoption leave is there?
faqs.a: The primary adopter may take up to 16 weeks of paid adoption leave.
